rule: docs/games/MODEL_QUALITY.md (parent repo) §2 and §2b, owner 29/10: Ultra the whole Tripo original with colour, normal and roughness maps; High the §2 floor and at most the original, colour and normal map (plus a small roughness map: §2.3 forbids one flat roughness); Medium about half of High's triangles, colour 1024 and a normal map; never under 2,000 triangles at Ultra, High or Medium. Low draws no 3D (the kit's primitives), unchanged. Orientation, size, pivot, sockets and cuts come from dragon-hold-m0b.json. Build: node scripts/models/m0b-tiers.mjs

character.note: foes, the general, the warden, traps: §2 keeps the original up to 20,000 triangles; textures as characters (2048 at High)

building.note: the hut, the bridge, the jetty: §2 keeps the original up to 25,000 triangles; textures as houses (2048 at High)

tree.note: big trees: §2 floor 8,000 at High; textures 1024 at High (§2.3 gives 2048 to characters, houses and landmarks only)

small.note: bushes, rocks, stumps, logs, fences, lanterns, cliff blocks: §2 floor 2,500 at High

cover.note: grass, flowers, reeds (dense, instanced): §2 row 1,500, lifted to the 2,000 floor at every tier

farNote: Scatter classes (tree, small, cover) also ship a far LOD: today's M0b cut (dragon-hold-m0b.json triangles), geometry only, drawn with the tier's maps beyond the LOD distance from the camera (view/scatter.ts; MODEL_QUALITY §3 step 2).
hullNote: Crowd classes (character, building) also ship a hull: the Medium mesh, geometry only; on High and Ultra the crowd draws its outline and ghost passes with it while the body keeps the tier mesh (view/crowd.ts; MODEL_QUALITY §3 step 2).
